Architecture¶

Core choices¶

CGAL isolation

Public headers under VMMLib/include/vmm must not include CGAL headers. CGAL belongs in private backend translation units.

Data-oriented topology

Hot mesh data is stored in contiguous arrays. Neighbour relations use CSR offsets and connectivity arrays.

Open extension points

Domain and site generation use concepts, traits, and registries. Closed enums are avoided for extension points.

Current 2D flow¶

PolygonalDomain2D
    -> site_generation::make_hexagonal_sites_2d
    -> tessellation::generate_clipped_voronoi_2d
    -> ClippedVoronoiMesh2D
    -> VTKExporter
